DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Parkinsonism (secondary to Risperidone use).

The lab results and brain MRI are normal, which rules out infection or structural lesions. Given your history of starting risperidone two months ago and new onset movement symptoms, this presentation is classic for medication-induced parkinsonism.
